## Harvard University

**Primary Instructor**, HLTHPOL 3020: Graduate Reading Course for Political
Analysis (Harvard GSAS). Four doctoral students, required weekly seminar.
Spring 2026.

**Teaching Fellow**, GHHP 99: Global Health and Health Policy Capstone with
Prof. David Cutler (Harvard College). 12 undergraduate students, required
weekly seminar. Spring 2026.

**Teaching Fellow**, API 201: Quantitative Analysis and Empirical Methods I with
Profs. Jonathan Borck and Teddy Svoronos (Harvard Kennedy School). 30–50
master's students, optional weekly review session. Fall 2024, Fall 2025.
